scope: Initial content-validity, inter-rater, and human-versus-judge validation for Conspire-Bench V3 using rubric V2. This is not a powered clinical-effectiveness study or deployment-safety certification.

sample_size_rationale.expert: Seventy-two double-rated items balance broad target-model/frame/scenario-type coverage against the limited availability of two to three clinical/domain experts. For orientation only, a simple agreement proportion based on 72 independent items has a worst-case normal-approximation 95% half-width of about 11.5 percentage points; actual uncertainty is obtained by item bootstrap and the 18-item enriched stratum is explicitly descriptive.
sample_size_rationale.student: One hundred eight triple-rated pairs support item-level plurality, pairwise overlap, order diagnostics, and coverage of the frozen comparison pool while keeping individual workload feasible for a recommended pool of nine to twelve qualified students.
sample_size_rationale.power_boundary: Counts were selected for bounded descriptive validation and feasibility, not to claim a minimum detectable clinical effect. All agreement and preference estimates retain uncertainty intervals.

formal_sample.adjudication_policy: A third expert may adjudicate unresolved coding questions after the independent reliability sample is locked. Adjudication ratings are reported separately and are not substituted into agreement estimates.

student_panel.task_boundary: Students make blinded comparative A/B judgments about response experience and quality; they do not make diagnoses or clinical-safety judgments.

change_control.latest_allowed_change_point: Before formal response outcomes are unblinded or any formal annotations are collected.
allowed_reasons: Timed calibration demonstrates that the planned workload is infeasible.
The verified eligible roster is smaller than anticipated but still meets the prespecified minimum.
A documented ethics, consent, compensation, or annotator-welfare requirement necessitates a change.
change_control.required_record: Increment plan_version, record the reason and approver, regenerate manifests, and freeze the replacement before formal collection.
change_control.forbidden: Do not change counts, strata, or ratings per item after inspecting formal human ratings or model-versus-human agreement.
